parsed.production_notes: The video uses human-recorded footage of an actor on a real beach, with a CGI/AI-generated robot character composited into the scene to interact with him.
parsed.interaction_pattern: AI tutor corrects a learner's common English mistake, then addresses the learner's concerns about ability and cost to pitch an app.
parsed.audio_track: Spoken dialogue in Tamil between a human learner and an AI tutor. There is no background music.

characters.appearance: A young South Indian man in his early to mid-20s with a slim build and a medium-dark complexion. He has short, neatly combed black hair and a light mustache. His facial features are pleasant and expressive.
characters.wardrobe: A short-sleeved, button-up shirt with a blue and white abstract pattern, and dark grey or black trousers.
characters.demeanor: Initially questioning and slightly hesitant, becoming convinced and enthusiastic by the end.

characters.appearance: A humanoid robot with a sleek, feminine form and a metallic grey finish. The robot has a defined face with no mouth, large dark eyes, and an articulated body with visible joints. Its design is futuristic and clean.
characters.demeanor: Calm, knowledgeable, and reassuring. Its movements are deliberate and its posture is poised.

scenes.setting: A sandy beach on a bright, sunny day. The ocean with gentle waves is in the background, and a red and white striped lighthouse is visible in the distance along the coastline.

scenes.visual_description: A medium shot of a young man (Character A) and a robot (Character B) sitting opposite each other on a beach. As they talk, text overlays appear. First, 'Interview-ல' appears. Then, 'Myself Karthik' appears with a large red X over it. This is replaced by 'I am Karthik' and then 'My name is Karthik' with a white checkmark. Other Tamil text captions for the dialogue appear and disappear at the bottom of the screen.
scenes.audio_transcript:
Character A says: இன்டர்வியூல 'Myself Karthik'னு இன்ட்ரோ குடுக்கலாமா? [In an interview, can I introduce myself as 'Myself Karthik'?]
Character B says: வேணாம் கார்த்திக். 'Myself' அப்படின்னு ஆரம்பிக்கிறது தப்பு. 'I am Karthik' இல்லனா 'My name is Karthik'னு சொல்லுங்க. அதான் கெத்தா இருக்கும். [No, Karthik. Starting with 'Myself' is wrong. Say 'I am Karthik' or 'My name is Karthik'. That will be stylish.]
Character A says: அட ஆமாம்பா. ஆனா எனக்கு இங்கிலீஷ் பேச வராதே. [Oh, yes. But I don't know how to speak English.]
Character B says: பயப்படாதீங்க. [Don't be afraid.]
